responsibility: Implements GCC’s branch-profiling and arc-instrumentation pass over CFGs. This file builds the minimal spanning tree used to minimize edge instrumentation, inserts edge and value-profiler counters, reads execution counts for profile-use, reconstructs and smooths basic-block/edge counts and branch probabilities from gcda data, updates loop and function frequencies, and maintains profiling statistics and the global profile_info summary. It is the main compiler pass that connects gcov counters to CFG-level execution profiles.
same_name_distinction: This is the CFG profiling pass implementation: it chooses instrumented arcs via spanning-tree construction, inserts edge/value profilers, reconstructs counts from gcda input, and computes branch and function frequencies. Unlike gcc/profile.h, it performs the actual pass algorithms rather than just exposing shared profiling data structures and entry points.
